L15@P1: We prove functorial weak factorization of projective birational morphisms of regular quasiexcellent
L16@P1: schemes in characteristic 0 broadly based on the existing line of proof for varieties. From this general
L17@P1: functorial statement we deduce factorization results for algebraic stacks, formal schemes, complex
L18@P1: analytic germs, Berkovich analytic and rigid analytic spaces, answering a present need in nonarchimedean
L19@P1: geometry. Techniques developed for this purpose include a method for functorial factorization of toric
L20@P1: maps, variation of GIT quotients relative to general noetherian qe schemes, and a GAGA theorem for
L21@P1: Stein compacts.

L32@P1: 1. Introduction
L33@P1: 1.1. The class of qe schemes (originally “quasiexcellent schemes”) is the natural class of schemes on
L34@P1: which problems around resolution of singularities are of interest. They can also be used as a bridge for
L35@P1: studying the same type of problems in other geometric categories; see [Temkin 2008, Section 5]. In this
L36@P1: paper we address the problem of functorial factorization of birational morphisms between regular qe
L37@P1: schemes of characteristic 0 into blowings up and down of regular schemes along regular centers. We rely
L38@P1: on general foundations developed in [Abramovich and Temkin 2017; 2018] and the approach for varieties
L39@P1: of [Włodarczyk 2000; Abramovich et al. 2002]. As a consequence of both this generality of qe schemes
